Entry panel · keep open on inside clicks

componentDescription.description: Code: Dialog(title, description?, primary, secondary, onDismiss). Click or tap the backdrop to dismiss. Clicking, scrolling and typing inside keeps the dialog open; explicit action buttons retain their actions. Escape/back and visible close buttons use the same dismissal handler. Dismissing does not cancel an already-requested save. Source contract: crumbs-design/design-system/component-contracts.json.
